title: 第4章 荣华得到食物和药物
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
【可以的，但古代世界只能赠送食物、布匹、药物等，任何超出小世界现阶段能容纳的物品都不行】

    【药物需要去除任何能泄露配方的包装，虽然是给另一个世界用，但版权意识咱们也要遵守】

    你还怪有道德感，花期在内心吐槽，又问：“那矿泉水瓶行不行？”

    【行，所有出自古城的东西，在丢弃或者用坏那一刻本系统会自动回收销毁，不会污染土地】

    花期心里有谱了，把三盒饭菜倒在塑料袋里，推到荣华面前，“这些菜你走的时候带走，给你家里人吃。”

    荣华惊诧抬头，见花期是认真的，眼角倏地一红，跪在地上磕了一个响头。

    “谢谢城主大人，您的大恩大德，荣华没齿难忘。”

    “咚——”

    结结实实一个响头，花期侧身避开了这一礼，“快起来，顺手的事情不用如此感恩，下午认真点干活。”

    荣华重重点头，面上满是认真，“城主大人，您放心，我一定会认真干活，绝对不会辜负您的好意。”

    ......

    下午太阳太大，花期为了避免中暑，让荣华戴上帽子和贴了冰冰贴，还喝了一支藿香正气液。

    冰冰贴的出现，让荣华立马抛弃了藿香正气液的瓶子，在脑门上稀罕地摸了又摸。

    这些仙物可真是神奇，什么也没添加，自己就凉快了，要是她们那边也有该多好。

    脑袋凉快了，荣华干活更起劲了。

    一整天的时间，她们几乎都在开荒。

    荒地野草太多太厚，即使只用镰刀收割，到了下午六点也才只清理出1.5亩的荒地，更别提还有许多杂草堆在地上没有清理。

    花期捶了捶酸痛的腰背，望着身后密密麻麻的野草，眼前便是一阵发黑。

    不行，明天还得找个熟手过来，至少得是干农活的一把手才行。

    这么多地，靠两个人开荒不知道要清理到哪一年，花钱请机器她也没钱，最少都是一千一天。

    星际的花销和蓝星不同，一千可能都还找不到机器人来干活。

    花期找出购买的种子，随便丢了两粒种子埋在没有草根的土里。

    她把水浇了，然后让荣华别干了。

    荣华也累惨了，闻言乖乖将镰刀放在种植区入口的地方，还将手套也给压在石头下面。

    在征得花期同意后，她用衣裙兜了一些野草回去。

    下午荣华干活的时候就发现了，这些野草比较有韧性，除非用刀割，不然很难折断。

    三弟妹会编织，野草拿回去能编个草席，晚上睡觉也不用担心石头咯人。

    荣华如实想着，脚下也不停，迅速跟着花期在天黑前离开种植区。
content_en:
[Yes, but the ancient world can only give away food, cloth, medicine, etc. Any items that exceed what the small world can accommodate at this stage are not acceptable]

    [Drugs need to remove any packaging that can reveal the formula. Although it is for use in another world, we must also abide by copyright awareness]

    You still have a sense of morality. Hua Qi complained in her heart and asked: "Can the mineral water bottle be okay?"

    [Okay, all things from the ancient city will be automatically recycled and destroyed the moment they are discarded or used, and will not pollute the land]

    Huaqi knew what was going on, so she poured three boxes of food into a plastic bag and pushed it in front of Ronghua, "Take these dishes with you when you leave for your family to eat."

    Rong Hua looked up in surprise and saw that Hua Qi was serious. The corners of his eyes suddenly turned red, and he knelt on the ground and kowtowed.

    "Thank you, City Lord, for your great kindness. Your glory will be unforgettable."

    "Dong——"

    With a solid nod of his head, Hua Qi turned sideways to avoid the gift, "Get up quickly. Don't be so grateful for easy things. Work more seriously in the afternoon."

    Ronghua nodded heavily, his face full of seriousness, "Lord City Lord, don't worry, I will work hard and will never let down your kindness."

    ...

    The sun was too strong in the afternoon. In order to avoid heatstroke during the flowering period, Ronghua had Ronghua put on a hat and ice cream, and drank a bottle of Huoxiang Zhengqi Liquid.

    The appearance of Bingbing sticker made Ronghua immediately abandon the bottle of Huoxiang Zhengqi liquid and touch his forehead curiously again and again.

    These fairy things are really magical. They don't add anything and they are cool by themselves. It would be great if they had them there too.

    With his head feeling cooler, Ronghua works more energetically.

    They spent almost the whole day clearing wasteland.

    There were so many weeds in the wasteland that they were too thick. Even if they were harvested with a sickle, only 1.5 acres of wasteland had been cleared by 6 p.m., not to mention that there were still many weeds piled on the ground that had not been cleared.

    Hua Qi slapped her sore back and looked at the dense weeds behind her, and her eyes suddenly turned black.

    No, we have to find a skilled worker to come over tomorrow, at least someone who is a leader in farm work.

    So much land needs to be cleared by two people for who knows how long it will take to clear it. She doesn't have the money to pay for machines. It's at least a thousand days.

    The cost of interstellar is different from that of blue star. It is possible that there are no robots to do the work.

    During the flowering period, I found the purchased seeds, threw two random seeds and buried them in the soil without grass roots.

    She poured the water and then told Ronghua to stop.

    Ronghua was also exhausted. Hearing this, he obediently placed the sickle at the entrance of the planting area and pressed his gloves under the stone.

    After asking for permission from Flowering Period, she carried some weeds back in her dress.

    When Ronghua was working in the afternoon, he discovered that these weeds are relatively tough and difficult to break unless cut with a knife.

    The third brother and sister can knit, and they can make straw mats out of weeds, so they don’t have to worry about rocks falling on them when they sleep at night.

    Ronghua thought truthfully, without stopping, he quickly followed the flowering period and left the planting area before dark.
title_en: Chapter 4 Ronghua gets food and medicine
